name: CSUMB Big Creek and Lopez Point 2009–2010 processed bathymetry and terrain grids

producer.name: California State University Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab; archived by NOAA NCEI

units.terrain_derived_roughness_class: derived class -31 rough, -30 smooth in the 30–100 m stratum

spatial.note: The original release has 2 m output for nominal 0–85 m depths and 5 m output for 80–250 m. Published grid spacing is not independent sounding spacing or positional accuracy.

temporal.update_cadence: Static survey; monthly source-byte and official protected-area recheck

provenance.access_service: NOAA NCEI original multibeam processed-product archive
transformations: Opened nested original ESRI bathymetry and habitat grids for Big Creek North, Big Creek South and Lopez Point; retained valid-cell masks and two disjoint 2 m/5 m comparison bands.
Joined the grid cells to current official CDFW Big Creek SMCA and SMR geometry with a 75 m research buffer; no MLLW transformation or fish target promotion.
Detailed file hashes, per-area counts and official MPA source hash are in dist/data/bigcreek-lopez-original-300-research.json.

evidence.supports: NCEI's Big Creek archive lists original processed products and survey metadata.
Downloaded hash-pinned archive contains paired original product depth and habitat grids at 2 m and 5 m for three survey areas.
Official CDFW geometry used for research proximity screen of Big Creek SMCA and SMR.
CSUMB states non-navigation use, attribution request and no for-profit use without express permission. Original product metadata leave use constraints to producer review.

limitations: Nominal NAVD88 200–300 ft grid band is not a chart-depth band; full-grid NAVD88-to-MLLW transform and a conservative combined uncertainty bound remain missing.
Published DEM cells were interpolated from decimated CUBE soundings. Terrain-derived rough class shares the same bathymetry and is not independent rock groundtruth.
The official Big Creek SMCA/SMR boundary is screened only as a research exclusion. Individual activity rules, ENC dangers, full approach/drift geometry and trip-date notices remain unreviewed.
No species presence, catch rate, rank or navigation/export waypoint follows from this source. Public grid redistribution and for-profit use are on hold pending source-specific permission.
